M006.label: favourable
M006.quote: The Moon's position gives a pure and fertile mind, not spiteful but somewhat vindictive, sensitive and discriminative and also worldly success.
M006.note: No explicit 5th-house intellect verdict; nearest conclusion is on the mind via Sun/Moon (discriminative, critical, pure and fertile mind).

M014.label: favourable
M014.quote: five planets-Jupiter, the Sun, Mercury, Venus and Mars — aspecting the 10th were mainly responsible for making him the idol of India.
M014.note: Also became India's first Prime Minister (line 12461).

M022.label: mixed
M022.quote: A very powerful Rajayoga is caused by the association of the lords of the 9th, 10th, 2nd and 5th, indicating his high birth and great political power, but the yoga, having occurred in the 12th or house of loss, caused the disappearance of all the indications
M022.note: Power attained then lost: 'No wonder that Tippu lost his life and empire' (line 5749); could be read as afflicted.

M030.label: mixed
M030.quote: Saturn's influence as a malefic lord on the 11th Rouse must give a limited number of elder brothers. The aspect of the Sun on the 11th house prevents denial of elder co-borns. The native has one elder brother.
M030.note: Limited but not denied; one elder brother.

M038.label: afflicted
M038.quote: causing the greatest mental strain to the native in the shape of misunderstandings with brothers, relatives and cousins ... he same combination gave separation and estrangement.

M046.label: afflicted
M046.quote: The native of Chart No. 249 was a celebrated jail-bird.

M054.label: favourable
M054.quote: His legal career was built up in Jupiter Dasa. He is said to have had a lucrative practice.
M054.note: Remarks also speak of 'a distinguished career' (line 11327); 'high educational attainments' (11253).

M062.label: favourable
M062.quote: The 7th house having no afflictions gives a happy married life. Ketu, fortified in the 7th, is good but nevertheless gives some points of difference due to the wife's sensitivity in some matters.

M070.label: favourable
M070.quote: The predominance of feminine signs and the powerful influence of Venus on the karaka has given more elder sisters than brothers. The native has 3 elder sisters and one elder brother.
M070.note: Saturn reduced the number but killed none.

M078.label: favourable
M078.quote: generated a powerful Dhana Yoga. Rahu in the 11th made the native own a chain of industries.

M086.label: afflicted
M086.quote: The house of children is not favourable.
M086.note: Raman then notes Wells had two sons by his second wife, so outcome is limited rather than denied.

M094.label: mixed
M094.quote: Saturn aspectmg the 11th house from the Moon give limited number of elder co-borns. The Moon's influence on karaka Mars in Navamsa cannot deny elder co-borns. The native has a lons surviving elder sister.
M094.note: Limited but not denied; one elder sister.

M102.label: favourable
M102.quote: native's fifth Bhava is fairly well disposed while the hand of Mars may cause an abortion or two to the wife.
M102.note: Eldest son born 1936 (line 13793); caveat is minor.

M110.label: afflicted
M110.quote: The papakartari yoga of the 7th lord Mars resulted in disharmony in married life when the wife left the husband on learning of his secret marriage.
M110.note: Two wives and a clandestine marriage.

M118.label: mixed
M118.quote: In this case the fortunes are subject to much change.
M118.note: Middle-class man; implicated in a defamation case but acquitted.

M126.label: favourable
M126.quote: Saturn is in the 3rd from Karakamsa suggesting that he was really a brave and courageous man.
M126.note: Conclusion lies at line 12288, outside the cited line 12097 but within Hitler's section.

M134.label: afflicted
M134.quote: These weaken the 9th house to some extent. The father of the native died in Rahu Bhukti of Saturn Dasa.
M134.note: Raman adds a different nakshatra 'would have prevented the father from dying in Saturn Dasa' (line 8634).

M142.label: favourable
M142.quote: The eleventh house as well as karaka Jupiter are very favourably disposed.
M142.note: As pontiff he gained control of 'vast properties all over the country' (line 15671).

M150.label: favourable
M150.quote: The Lagna is conspicuously strong, inasmuch as it is occupied by Jupiter, gnanakaraka, and lord of the 9th
M150.note: Remarks: vitality of Lagna 'rendered the man visionary and yet practical' (line 9551); one year in jail noted separately.

M158.label: afflicted
M158.quote: the native has to experience sorrow on account of the 5th house. The sign from which Mars aspects the 5th house is a fiery one. The native's wife had 4 or 5 abortions and no fully developed children were born.

M166.label: afflicted
M166.quote: The presence of Ketu in the 7th, Rahu's affliction to Venus coupled with the papakartari yoga to the 8th house from the Moon resulted in the native, a Hindu, marrying a Christian colleague.
M166.note: Outcome is an unconventional inter-faith marriage attributed to afflictions; no explicit statement of unhappiness.

M174.label: mixed
M174.quote: In whatever he does, he will be generally confronted with obstacles and delay but as Lagna is strongly disposed, the ultimate objects will be realised.
M174.note: Also 'great achievements but ... the life is often unhappy' (line 14511); could be read favourable.

M182.label: favourable
M182.quote: The lord of the 9th Moon is exalted in the 7th and aspected by the lord of 5th Jupiter. A more ideal combination tor a Pontiff cannot be conceived.

M190.label: none
M190.note: Rajendra Prasad's section says nothing about his mother; the 4th lord is used only for education (line 11252).

M198.label: favourable
M198.quote: The 9th lord occupies a kendra. The 9th house from the Moon is fortified while the 9th house from Lagna has no afflictions.
M198.note: Mostly factor weighing, then timing of father's death when native was about 32; not described as early loss.

M206.label: favourable
M206.quote: Note the native acquired a fine car in Jupiter Dasha Venus Bhukti and a decent house in Jupiter Dasha Mars Bhukti.

M214.label: mixed
M214.quote: He had to encounter a lot of opposition from other scientists ... Rahu in the 5th enabled him to overcome all opposition. Truth prevailed in the end and his theories were accepted.
M214.note: Suffered prejudice and opposition but overcame it.

M222.label: favourable
M222.quote: The 12th house is hemmed in between Lagna lord Venus and Atmakaraka the Sun who are in mutual parivartana indicating the blazing spirituality of the native.

M230.label: mixed
M230.quote: The native has 3 elder co-borns surviving While one elder brother died.
M230.note: Benefic factors give elder co-borns; papakartari from the Moon results in one brother's death (line 14935).

M238.label: favourable
M238.quote: The powerful combination of the 2nd, 7th, 9th and 11th lords in the 7th house, a kendra, has generated a very strong yoga for gains.
M238.note: Text split by chart block; continues at line 15309 (newspaper magnate).

M246.label: afflicted
M246.quote: The 5th house is equally afflicted as the lord Mars is with Rahu and Saturn.
M246.note: Brief house judgment; native became a sanyasi, no mention of children.

M254.label: none
M254.note: Raman calls it a 'peculiar and exceptional union' and 'a marriage that is out of the common' (line 14317) and notes legacy through marriage and the wife's death in Saturn Dasa, but gives no good or bad verdict.

M262.label: favourable
M262.quote: The native is married to a chaste and devoted wife.

M270.label: afflicted
M270.quote: Ill-health and financial troubles were too much for him. ... But beginning from the latter part of Rahu Dasa, misfortune dogged him.

M278.label: afflicted
M278.quote: These are adverse indications denying the birth of brothers.

M286.label: afflicted
M286.quote: The native was a glutton for sexual experiences and could never adapt himself to the restraints of marriage.

M294.label: mixed
M294.quote: VidyaKaraka's affliction resulted in the native getting very ordinary school education. But the fairly strong disposition of the fourth house and the lord rendered him acquire knowledge of men and matters
M294.note: Formal schooling ordinary (Raman then defines education as formal), worldly knowledge good; afflicted is also defensible.

M302.label: afflicted
M302.quote: Saturn in the 2nd, Venus in the 8th and Mars and Ketu in the 7th from the Moon are indicative of not much happiness from wife.

M310.label: afflicted
M310.quote: This chart belongs to a woman who married in 1961 and sepa. rated from her husband in 1964. The marriage while it lasted was not at all happy.

M318.label: afflicted
M318.quote: All factors relating to the 7th house being afflicted with no redeeming beneficial influences deprived the native completely of any marital happiness.
